spans.text: A jifa mahoingɔ ndiamɔyei na ndɔlesialuahu i lɛgulɔma,

folded.id: mahoungɔ|sawei|i tɔ kɛ hugbatei ji ɛɛ numugbi gbukpuu
folded.subject: Mahoungɔ
folded.object: i tɔ kɛ hugbatei ji ɛɛ numugbi gbukpuu

spans.text: Mahoungɔ sawei i tɔ kɛ hugbatei ji ɛɛ numugbi gbukpuu.

folded.id: mia kɔɔ|sawei|i baagɔɔ ngi nuvuu ya ma mia leke gbi
folded.subject: mia kɔɔ
folded.object: i baagɔɔ ngi nuvuu ya ma mia leke gbi

spans.text: Nuvuu gbi lee ngi lɔnya mia kɔɔ sawei i baagɔɔ ngi nuvuu ya ma mia leke gbi.

folded.id: ngewɔi|na|a feli
folded.subject: Ngewɔi
folded.object: a feli

spans.text: Hugbatei ji numu kpɛlɛɛ lɔ va, nu gɛnyɛi, ngi luwu yɛgii, nyaha ɔɔ hindgo, nu layia, Ngewɔi na a feli, ngi gilii yei, ngi le gi kɛɛ ngi gbatɛ ii ma.

folded.id: ngi ndei|na|hu mia i gbuanina
folded.subject: ngi ndei
folded.object: hu mia i gbuanina

spans.text: Nuu gbi ngi lɔnya mia kɔɔ i gbua ndɔlɔ yila hu i li peka hu, i wee a ngi yee ɔɔ mbaa tinda, tao kɔɔ i yama ngi ndei na hu mia i gbuanina.

folded.id: office|of|the united nations high commissioner for human rights (ohchr)
folded.subject: Office
folded.object: the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR)

spans.text: Universal Declaration of Human Rights Language: Mende (men) Adopted: UN General Assembly resolution 217 A (III), Paris, 10 December 1948 Publisher: Office of the United Nations High Commissioner for Human Rights (OHCHR)

folded.id: pie hindangaa|na|hii i wotɛa a nɛmahugili waa nuvuu ma
folded.subject: pie hindangaa
folded.object: hii i wotɛa a nɛmahugili waa nuvuu ma

spans.text: A jifa ngawulɛɛhu kɛɛ baagbuala nuvugaa ti lɔnyisia ma ti wanga a pie hindangaa na hii i wotɛa a nɛmahugili waa nuvuu ma, dunya ninahu mia mahoingɔ muvuu i gu i yɛpɛ kia ngi longɔla, kɛɛ ngi lanayei kɛɛ ngi lima hinda.

folded.id: taa nyahii|na|ti lakpangɔ ta sɔɔwelɔ ti ndengaa le
folded.subject: taa nyahii
folded.object: ti lakpangɔ ta sɔɔwelɔ ti ndengaa le

spans.text: Hindui taa nyahii na ti lakpangɔ ta sɔɔwelɔ ti ndengaa le, ti gɛnyɛ ii yɛni bɛɛ yila, tii yɛni bɛɛ a ndɔlɔ yila hunblaa, ɔɔ Ngewɔ veli gbambi yila ma.

folded.id: tao mahoungɔ|sawei|i ti mahu wɛɛ nahi gbi ɛɛ ti hu wɔyɔ
folded.subject: tao mahoungɔ
folded.object: i ti mahu wɛɛ nahi gbi ɛɛ ti hu wɔyɔ

spans.text: Nuvuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maahɛwungɔɛ sawei gulɔ, tao mahoungɔ sawei i ti mahu wɛɛ nahi gbi ɛɛ ti hu wɔyɔ.

folded.id: ti maahɛwungɔɛ|sawei|gulɔ
folded.subject: ti maahɛwungɔɛ
folded.object: gulɔ

spans.text: Nuvuu kpɛlɛɛ ti maahɛwungɔɛ sawei gulɔ, tao mahoungɔ sawei i ti mahu wɛɛ nahi gbi ɛɛ ti hu wɔyɔ.

folded.id: ti woyilɛi|na|hu ti lanaya gɛnga kɔlɔ yayilingɔihu
folded.subject: ti woyilɛi
folded.object: hu ti lanaya gɛnga kɔlɔ yayilingɔihu

spans.text: A jifa nungei nasia ti ndɔlei kpɛlɛ ti woyilɛi na hu ti lanaya gɛnga kɔlɔ yayilingɔihu,

folded.id: wili hugbatɛhu|na|ngenga blaa ma vale
folded.subject: wili hugbatɛhu
folded.object: ngenga blaa ma vale

spans.text: Ngenge mɔgbi lɔnya mia kɔɔ i wili hugbatɛhu na ngenga blaa ma vale.

folded.id: ye njie|na|le fofohu
folded.subject: ye njie
folded.object: le fofohu

spans.text: Nuu gbi ngi lɔnya mia nahii ti la nyɔngaa ngi ma tɛ i ngi maahinda gulanga kɔlɛhu ɔɔ i sawa kpoukpou nyaninga, kɔɔ ti ye njie na le fofohu, tao kɔɔ sawakpambu jein jein gɔngaa ti loo ngi va.
Nuu gbi ngi lɔnya mia nahi ti la nyɔngaa ngi ma hinda ngamu va, taa kiti lewe haani ti ye njie na le fofohu, tao ti jia a sawe panda pandaa.

folded.id: ye|sawei|ji ɛɛ lɛkpɛ gbi naleke ye numui ji i ndɔlɔ jawa nyanini
folded.subject: Ye
folded.object: ji ɛɛ lɛkpɛ gbi naleke ye numui ji i ndɔlɔ jawa nyanini

spans.text: Ye sawei ji ɛɛ lɛkpɛ gbi naleke ye numui ji i ndɔlɔ jawa nyanini, tao i hinda gbulaninga na ndɔlɔ woyila hugbatɛi i loila.
